City of Chicago
                                                                    02021-2137
                            Office of the City Clerk

                           Document Tracking Sheet




Meeting Date:                 5/26/2021
Sponsor(s):                    Ervin (28)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 1-K at 4008 W Madison St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B1-3,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-K in
the area bound by:

      the alley next north of and parallel West Madison Street; a line 50 west of and parallel to
      North Pulaski Avenue; West Madison Street; and a line 150 feet west of and parallel to
      North Pulaski Avenue,

to those of a POS-2, Parks and Open Space District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           Jason C. Ervin
                                                           Alderman, 28*'' Ward




Common Address:
4008 W. Madison Street
